title: What If AI & The Register
_note_base_url: Used for canonical links, the sitemap and the 404 page. Change it here (and only here) if the site moves to a custom domain.
_note_bundles: Order matters. CSS: base, then the page's own rules, then the theme layers (as in the single-file pages). JS runs in list order after the data has loaded.
csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
_note_csp: Delivered as a <meta> tag (GitHub Pages cannot set headers). No inline scripts or style attributes are allowed; the page data is JSON, fetched from the same origin.
